status: Local candidate complete and original preview promoted; human listening/playtest and physical-device limits remain explicit.
request: Repair fresh-browser nearby listening, expose nearby real-player chat and private-room actions, make contributions and shared changes more visible, restore a populated coffee setting, and make nearby panels dismissible.

source.scope: All final TypeScript source passed 213 checks. Final 23-check scene run covers the final runtime including explicit focus priority, final panel CSS and both phone interiors. The earlier 43-check creation and 30-check social runs retain their exact source scopes.

rollback.rule: Switch retained application files while keeping the current database. Never restore an older database to roll back visuals or controls.

implementation.preserved: Original identity cookies, planet and coastal rooms, public and private sound semantics, authors, coordinates, timestamps, tombstones, response history and current database.
implementation.audio: The near field is stronger while existing distance boundaries remain. Running/suspended context status, explicit sound entry, local zero-volume recovery and explicit-focus voice priority make local listening discoverable. Other players never unmute this browser.
implementation.chat: A visible nearby Talk action and T shortcut use the existing real-player twelve-metre in-memory chat. Input does not steer the avatar. NPCs never count as recipients or humans; messages are not persisted.
implementation.privateRooms: Actual proximity controls expose entering, explicit Flush/Run shower, leaving and resident invitation. Existing server occupancy gates remain authoritative. Own door stays closed away from the exit; temporary stay sound ends on leaving.
implementation.sharedSurrounds: A canonical two-author living response grows a broad source-coloured floor and overhead paper-leaf canopy, rhythmic garland or lantern form. Phase uses server time. Muting never changes topology; reduced motion preserves the result. Removal withdraws the active effect.
implementation.sourceCues: Original folded-paper buds, glass centres, soft ground glow and ripples replace isolated torus markers. Four geometries are pooled per world; per-source instance buffers and animated materials are released on removal. No PointLight is added. A visual marker means a contribution exists, not that local audio is playing.

coffeeHouse.description: Open front, counter, coffee machine, tables, cups and striped patio parasols. Three additional locally rendered role:npc regulars join the existing resident. Nearby living public espresso, music and company ingredients drive steam, record and cup/window effects. Private, removed and distant sources cannot activate them. No NPC creates a user or sound contribution.
coffeeHouse.rendering: Ten cups use four instanced draws; sixteen separate parasol panels use two vertex-coloured draws. These save fifty ordinary mesh draws relative to the unbatched new design, not a claim of measured physical-phone frame rate.

implementation.panels: Work and source cards close and explicitly reopen. Minimising the work also dismisses the automatic source card; only one work reopen pill occupies its lane. Dismissal survives a closer new source. Keyboard focus and expanded explanation survive shared updates.

finalSourceSpecs.scope: Full final TypeScript source checked against its own isolated database; final CSS-only reopen collision correction is additionally covered by the final scene run.

fullCreation.scope: Actual independent browser identities, complete Listening Green, Pocket Jam and Reading paths, live source/reply projection, real audio nodes, local quiet preference, touch/keyboard, removal, controlled logical frame loss/reconnect and strict test-owned cleanup. The later explicit-focus voice prioritisation is separately tested; it is not included in this browser source version.

socialPrivateRooms.scope: Two independent cookie identities, actual nearby messages, occupied-door walking and server rejection, browser flush/shower nodes, quiet-browser protection, 390x844 touch actions and resident admission/flush/release. Ordinary planet and coastal history unchanged. This run preceded the indoor-camera correction.

sceneEarlier.scope: Zero-volume recovery, focus/details preservation, shared cafe state, phone Share/library actions and five-source cleanup. Earlier result precedes the final collapse/reopen-pill changes.

sceneFinal.scope: Two independent cookie identities; current local audio activation and zero-volume recovery; focus/details retained after reply; both dismiss/reopen paths without stacked cards or intercepted work reopen; three authored cafe effects identical in both browsers; phone navigation, Share and first library actions; actual toilet and shower body-clearance/exit restoration; exact original Reading fixture and cleanup of all five own contributions. Touch emulation, no artistic/human listening claim.

worldGeometryAndLifecycles.scope: Actual Three.js buffers, meshes, instance matrices, wall/roof ray intersections, canonical poses, reduced motion, public/private filtering and disposal. Only sign-writing canvases are stubbed. No renderer, ear judgement or HTTP writes in this focused run.

negativeControls.result: Real room ray/visibility check fails; the earlier tree sightline check passes.

Touch walking outside restores the visible third-person body without changing the preference.
indoorPhoneTargeted.notVerified: This earlier targeted harness remained partial. Its coverage gap is closed by sceneFinal: both actual phone room renders hide the body indoors and restore it after exit.

audioOutput.scope: Actual browser destination Analyser samples from a trusted click and in-memory test source, plus controlled source-level checks. This proves sampled output and headroom under the fixture, not hardware audibility, pleasantness, loop quality or Nick's exact device.

latestFocusChecks.negativeScope: Before the explicit-focus fix, both new crowded-mix focus assertions fail; twenty-five unrelated cases were skipped by that targeted run. The final complete audio pair has twenty-eight passing tests.

visualReview.kind: Developer observation and automation; no novice study or artistic acceptance
observed: Actual new social screenshot shows folded contribution buds, broad canopy and populated coffee front.
Root manual close cafe visit showed front, counter, staff and regulars clearly enough; a roof cutaway was considered and rejected for this arrival view.
Actual phone private-room screenshot exposed the old giant back-of-head obstruction and led to the indoor-camera rule.
Valid targeted restroom phone screenshot was manually inspected after the fix; body is clear and Flush/Walk outside remain available.
Root inspected the final 1920x1080 cafe and 390x844 collapsed Green captures; people, source buds and actual reduced panel state are visible.
Final 390x844 restroom and shower images were inspected after the stable scene run; simplified furnishings remain, but the obstructing body is removed and scene actions are readable.
visualReview.unconfirmedObservation: A visual impression of duplicate Run/Jump controls was not supported by source inspection: the touch direction cluster contains only four arrows and the action pair is single. No control was hidden on that basis.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: Initial focused geometry command omitted APP_URL and inherited the global setup wait for unavailable port8080.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Used an ignored local-only geometry config without HTTP global setup. No source test executed in that first attempt.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: A full-source check during concurrent social work saw an untyped Promise mock; new cup batching initially used a spread tuple TypeScript rejected.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: The social mock was corrected by its owner; cup offsets use explicit three coordinates. Final typecheck passed.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: Initial single-heading indoor fixture passed even with the old visibility rule, so it did not reproduce the new risk.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Expanded real geometry to three positions and four headings per hut and requires genuine collisions between1.15 and2.5metres. The old rule then fails the test.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: Scene fixture writes and cleanup first met the existing one-second rate limit.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Retained the server policy, paced the fixture and removed its exact orphan through the owning fixture identity; absence was confirmed.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: Actual 390x844 Share was covered by Run and a native tap hit Run.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Gave Share a separate lane and prevented passive notices intercepting input.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: Minimising the work uncovered an automatic nearby card; a closer new source could reopen a dismissed card.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Minimise dismisses the automatic card and dismissal survives nearest-source changes. The later work/source reopen pills collided on desktop; root kept the source reopen hidden while any work dock is visible. The final 23-check scene rerun verified native click and touch behaviour.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: Full creation first completed34checks but its fresh database lacked the historical Reading bird fixture. First fixture preparation also confused Playwright and native-fetch response APIs.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Prepared through the public API, corrected the test-only response convention and completed a distinct43-check rerun. No direct database edits or partial-run relabelling.

failuresAndCorrections.observation: First targeted indoor phone run entered the restroom twice because it checked old walkingIntent=false before the switched card named the shower.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Retained the valid restroom checks and screenshot; changed the ignored harness to wait the target hut. The second run timed out waiting for the welcome role locator; its failure screenshot shows the welcome rendered, no join error or page error. The shower browser check remains unverified and GPU was released instead of claiming completion. The final stable scene suite then completed both room camera paths; the earlier partial artifact is not relabelled.

dataAndPromotion.rule: Retain the current original database for all application changes/rollback. The safe utility stopped only the verified listener, took a stable fresh snapshot and backup, compared all persistent rows and verified served bytes/no-cache.

limitations: Human ear/hardware listening and the artistic quality of the revised mix are not verified. Nick's exact browser/device has not been reproduced.
No two uncoached friend pairs, voluntary recombination, motivation to return or actual next-day return are claimed.
Mobile checks use390x844 touch emulation, not physical-phone performance or Safari hardware.
No public deployment, main push or access-permission change is authorised or performed.
Interior furnishings remain deliberately simple and the outdoor view under a doorway can still be close. This is an interaction/camera fix, not an assertion of refined interior art.
The full historical coastal browser chain was not rerun for this planet-only revision; source checks and actual browser snapshots confirm original coastal contributions remain exact.
